content.value_statement: Producing useful marketing video requires many tool and format decisions. This skill gives structured workflows for AI video, avatars, repurposing, and programmatic rendering.
actual_capabilities: Recommends video production approaches for demos, explainers, social clips, ads, and tutorials.
Compares AI generation, AI avatars, editing tools, Hyperframes, and Remotion.
Provides video prompting guidance for subject, action, camera, style, mood, and technical specs.
Outlines workflows for product demos, explainers, batch social clips, and repurposed webinars.
Covers platform-aware export choices, including social, website, and YouTube formats.
Points users to related tool guides and complementary marketing skills.
limitations: It does not render or edit video by itself.
Tool availability, pricing, and model limits may change after the skill text was written.
AI video models may fail with accurate product screens, readable text, or real locations.
Users still need scripts, assets, brand context, and final human review.

use_cases.title: Plan a SaaS Product Demo
use_cases.description: Choose a fast workflow using screen recordings, overlays, captions, and optional AI B-roll.

use_cases.title: Repurpose Long-Form Content
use_cases.description: Turn webinars, podcasts, or demos into platform-ready clips with captions and aspect-ratio guidance.

use_cases.title: Build Repeatable Video Pipelines
use_cases.description: Design template-based video workflows for product updates, personalized outreach, or batch content.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Video Approach
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose the best production approach for a [video type] aimed at [audience] on [platform]. Ask for any missing context first.

prompt_templates.title: Write an AI Video Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a concise AI video prompt for [scene]. Include subject, action, camera movement, visual style, lighting, mood, and aspect ratio.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Product Demo Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a step-by-step production plan for a [length] product demo using our existing assets: [assets]. Include tool choices and export specs.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Batch Video Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a repeatable pipeline for [number] personalized videos using [data source], [avatar or voiceover], and [visual template]. Include review checkpoints.

output_examples.input: We need a two-minute SaaS homepage demo video.
output: Recommended workflow: script the main value points, record the real product flow, add programmatic overlays, include captions, and export in 16:9.
Use AI B-roll only for supporting lifestyle or abstract scenes, not for exact product screens.

output_examples.input: I need a short landing page B-roll clip of someone using a laptop.
output_examples.output: The skill would suggest suitable AI video tools and provide a structured prompt with subject, action, camera movement, lighting, mood, and resolution.

output_examples.input: We have a one-hour webinar and need social clips.
output: Clean the source video, extract the strongest moments, add captions, format clips for vertical channels, and review hooks before publishing.
Use platform-specific ratios for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

best_practices: Define the video goal, audience, length, and platform before choosing tools.
Use real product footage for accurate UI, then add overlays and captions programmatically.
Review short samples before spending budget on batch generation or avatar production.
anti_patterns: Do not ask AI video models to render important readable text.
Do not generate product screens when accurate UI is required.
Do not produce many personalized videos before reviewing sample quality.

faq.question: Does this skill create videos directly?
faq.answer: No. It guides video production workflows and tool choices. External tools perform rendering, generation, editing, or avatar creation.

faq.question: Which tools does the skill discuss?
faq.answer: It covers Hyperframes, Remotion, HeyGen, Synthesia, Veo, Sora, Runway, Kling, Pika, Descript, Opus Clip, CapCut, and related tools.

faq.question: Can it help with product demo videos?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends real screen recordings, scripted value points, overlays, captions, and platform-specific export settings.

faq.question: Can it help with social video clips?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a repurposing workflow for webinars, podcasts, demos, and other long-form sources.

faq.question: Does it replace video editing judgment?
faq.answer: No. Users should still review pacing, accuracy, brand fit, accessibility, and final quality before publishing.

faq.question: Is current pricing guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. The skill links to vendor pricing or documentation when current details may change.
